cohort: Women who experienced PPH within the first 24 hours after delivery over a 3-year period
finding: Previous cesarean delivery, prolonged labor, oxytocin augmentation, and emergency cesarean delivery were the strongest predictors of severe blood loss in women with PPH.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean delivery, prolonged labor, oxytocin augmentation and emergency cesarean delivery were the strongest predictors of severe blood loss in women with PPH.
